about: The Obsidian subfolder rule (T7.4h, T14.29): what the Obsidian page stores for a typed subfolder, or why it refuses it. crates/earshot-runtime (export_settings_tests.rs) runs every case through `export_settings::check_folder` (`stored` is what it returns; `message` is the refusal's `message()`, the text the Obsidian page shows), and packages/ui/src/ipc/vaultFolder.test.ts through the mock's `checkFolder` (the same `stored`, or the same IpcError message). Saving only: a value stored by an earlier version is read by its own rule (`stored_folder`), which the mock does not mirror because it never re-checks what it holds. A rule or copy change edits both and this table. Every name is invented.
